import filecmp
import importlib.machinery
import logging.handlers
import zipimport


def publish_smtp(handler: logging.handlers.SMTPHandler, record: object) -> None:
    handler.emit(record)


class Publisher:
    handler: logging.handlers.DatagramHandler

    def publish(self, record: object) -> None:
        self.handler.emit(record)


def load_archive(loader: zipimport.zipimporter) -> bytes:
    return loader.get_data("decision.py")


def compare_names(comparison: filecmp.dircmp) -> list[str]:
    return comparison.left_list


def load_source(loader: importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader) -> bytes:
    return loader.get_data("decision.py")


importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("decision", "decision.py").get_data("decision.py")
